Great question — pairing it well can really improve the overall feel and performance.
A simple, solid setup is:
A supportive sports bra to keep everything secure during lifts and movement. 
A fitted crop top or tank for unrestricted movement and a clean silhouette.
A zip jacket or hoodie for warm-ups, travel, or cooler gyms.
For the base layer, many people choose seamless underwear (like a thong) to avoid visible lines and keep the fit smooth under tight leggings. 
You can also match the leggings with a coordinating sports bra for a clean, streamlined look.

• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question — getting the most out of it is mostly about how you train and recover.
Train each muscle group 2–3 times per week with about 10–12 sets per session and reps in the 6–30 range. 
Focus on progressive overload (gradually increasing weight or reps over time).
Keep 1–2.5 minutes rest between sets and aim for 7–9 hours of sleep for recovery.
Eat enough protein and fuel your workouts with carbs to support muscle repair and growth.
Try 30–70 seconds of time under tension per set to maximise muscle stimulation. 
Consistency + proper recovery is what really makes the difference 💙
